simple.meaning: to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּבָה (H3518) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 24 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.short: to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger)
definitions.full: H3518. kabah [ כָּבָה ] verb be quenched, extinguished, go out , of fire or lamp (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּבָא id. of light of eyes (rare)) — Qal Perfect 3plural כָּבוּ Isa 43:17 ; Imperfect יִכְבֶּה 1Sam 3:3 ; Prov 21:18 ; 3 feminine singular תִּכְבֶּה Lev 6:5 10 t.; Infinitive construct כְּבוֺתְךָ Ezek 32:7 ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Co ( ׳כַּבּ ᵑ0 Pi) — be quenched, extinguished (c. negative except 1Sam 3:3 ; Prov 26:20 ; Isa 43:17 ), of lamp ( אֱלֹהִים נֵר ) in sanctuary 1Sam 3:3 ; of altar-fire Lev 6:5 ; 6:6 ; of נֵרָהּ Prov 31:18 ; of bodies of renegade Israelites Isa 66:24 (compare בֶןהִֿנֹּם גֵּיא ); subject אֵשׁ figurative of contention Prov 26:20 ; figurative, subject fire kindled by ׳י Ezek 21:3 ; 21:4 ; subject wrath ( חֵמָה ) of ׳י 2Kin 22:17 2Chr 34:25 ; Jer 7:20 ; wrath under figure of fire ( אֵשׁ ) 17:27 ; so of burning land of Edom Isa 34:10 ; of annihilation of Yahweh's enemies 43:17 ( כַּמִּשְׁתָּה ; || דָּעַךְ ), compare Pharaoh Ezek 32:7 (see above) Pi`el Perfect וְכִבּוּ consecutive 2Sam 14:7 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יְכַבֶּנָּה Isa 42:3 ; 2 masculine singular תְּכַבֶּה 2Sam 21:17 ; וַיְכַבּוּ 2Chr 29:7 ; Infinitive כַּבּוֺת Song 8:7 ; also כַּבּוֺתְךָ ᵑ0 Ezek 32:7 (but compare above); Participle מְכַבֶּה Isa 1:31 3 t.; — quench, extinguish , figurative except 2Chr 29:7 (of extinguishing lamps, נֵרוֺת , in temple); followed by יִשְׂרָאֵל נֵר (figurative for life of David) 2Sam 21:17 ; followed by גַּחַלְתִּי ( coal = family-hope) 14:7 (of killing widow's only son); followed by כֵהָה מִּשְׁתָּה Isa 42:3 dimly-burning wick (figurative of spiritually weak); implied object reference to wrath of ׳י Amos 5:6 ; Jer 4:4 ; 21:12 ; to people and idols Isa 1:31 ; followed by love אַהֲבָה Song 8:7 (subject רַבִּים מַיִם ); Ezek 32:7 compare above
